scenarios.name: Dismiss temporary Home commands when activating an open part

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is open in the MCAD Software
the ribbon is minimized to tabs
the Tools ribbon tab is visible
the user clicks the Tools ribbon tab
the Home-context Tools commands appear temporarily
the user selects the open part document tab
the part workspace and model browser appear
the temporary Home-context commands are closed
the part ribbon remains minimized to tabs
the Tools ribbon tab is selected
